message: I was at a friend's place the other night when their smoke alarm went off unexpectedly. You know that one friend who panics? Yep, that was them! They started running around like a chicken with its head cut off, while I just calmly checked the stove. Thankfully, it was just some burnt popcorn! 😂 It reminded me how important it is to have a solid escape plan and practice kitchen safety. Just a little prep can keep everyone calm when things heat up.
